sample_unit: standardised questions (posed in English and Spanish to each of 4 models)

links.outcome: Readability of AI responses on atrial fibrillation (Flesch-Szigriszt) by model and language
links.effect: Significant readability differences between models (P < .01); ChatGPT performed best but its content was moderately challenging in Spanish and highly challenging in English.
links.quote: The ChatGPT demonstrated the highest performance, although its content was moderately challenging in Spanish and highly challenging in English.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient information relative to patient needs
links.effect: Readability significantly differed between models (P < .01); even the best model, ChatGPT, was moderately challenging in Spanish and highly challenging in English.
links.quote: The ChatGPT demonstrated the highest performance, although its content was moderately challenging in Spanish and highly challenging in English.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs on reliability and readability of patient-facing atrial fibrillation answers across English and Spanish without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
